title: Classes That Fit
transcript: At an adult education centre, the instructor of a bookkeeping course noticed an odd pattern. Some learners attended three evenings in a row and then disappeared for a week. Their employers assigned shifts at short notice, so the learners could rarely promise to come on a particular evening. The centre began offering the same lesson on two different days and let people choose their session each week. It also provided a short practice sheet for anyone who missed both sessions. By the end of the term, more learners had completed the full sequence of exercises. The evening classes drew uneven crowds, however, with one room sometimes filling up while the other was half empty. The centre now asks learners to reserve a place once their work schedules are posted.

questions.prompt: What made it difficult for learners to attend on a fixed evening?
options: They had to share their bookkeeping materials.
Their work shifts were assigned at short notice.
The instructor often changed the lesson time.
Their employers required them to take another course.
questions.answer: Their work shifts were assigned at short notice.
questions.explanation: 雇主临时排班，学员很难提前承诺某个晚上一定能到。

questions.prompt: What is the likely purpose of the new reservation request?
options: To identify which learners need help with bookkeeping
To encourage employers to give learners the same days off
To decide which exercises should be taught first
To anticipate how many learners will come to each session
questions.answer: To anticipate how many learners will come to each session
questions.explanation: 两个场次的人数有时相差很大，提前预约能让中心预估每场的到课人数。
